2. Bayesian Likelihood Invariance & Prior Conservation

Why does the assertion "Lord Krishna is real (as God incarnate)" resist empirical adjudication with mathematical certainty? In Bayesian epistemology, belief updating is governed by Bayes' Theorem:

$$P(H \mid E) = \frac{P(E \mid H) \cdot P(H)}{P(E)}$$

Or in odds form: $$O(H_1 : H_2 \mid E) = \frac{P(E \mid H_1)}{P(E \mid H_2)} \cdot O(H_1 : H_2)$$

Where the term $\frac{P(E \mid H_1)}{P(E \mid H_2)}$ is the Bayes Factor ($BF_{12}$).

Mathematical Proof of Likelihood Equivalence:

Let $H_{\text{theo}}$ be the theistic hypothesis that Lord Krishna is Svayam Bhagavān incarnate in human form. Let $H_{\text{nat}}$ be the naturalistic baseline that a historical mortal Vṛṣṇi chieftain lived, whose deeds were mythologized by oral bardic traditions. Let $E \in \mathcal{E}_{\text{phys}}$ be any physically realizable observable in the universe (pottery shards, soil pH, iron metallurgy, radiocarbon ratios, bone fragments).

Under orthodox Hindu theology (Bhagavad Gītā 4.6, 7.25, 9.11), the Avatāra willingly assumes the constraints of human nature (mānuṣīṁ tanum āśritam):

avajānanti māṁ mūḍhā mānuṣīṁ tanum āśritam | paraṁ bhāvam ajānanto mama bhūta-maheśvaram || ("Fools deride Me when I descend in human form, unaware of My transcendent nature as Supreme Lord of all beings.")

Because the theological doctrine posits that the physical body, biological life, social relationships, mortality, and post-mortem cremation of the Avatāra operate within ordinary empirical nature under yoga-māyā, the probability distribution of all physical observables is identical under both hypotheses:

$$\forall E \in \mathcal{E}_{\text{phys}}, \quad P(E \mid H_{\text{theo}}) \equiv P(E \mid H_{\text{nat}})$$

The Theorem of Prior Conservation:

Because $BF(E) = \frac{P(E \mid H_{\text{theo}})}{P(E \mid H_{\text{nat}})} = 1.000000$ for all physical evidence classes:

$$O(H_{\text{theo}} : H_{\text{nat}} \mid E) = 1.0 \cdot O(H_{\text{theo}} : H_{\text{nat}}) \equiv O(H_{\text{theo}} : H_{\text{nat}})$$

The posterior odds are strictly equal to the prior odds. Furthermore, the information gain measured by the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence is:

$$\Delta I = D_{\text{KL}}(P(\Theta \mid E) \parallel P(\Theta)) = \log_2(BF) = \log_2(1.0) = 0.000000 \text{ bits}$$

[!IMPORTANT] Fundamental Epistemic Invariance: No volume of archaeological excavation ($N \to \infty$), no resolution of satellite remote sensing, and no precision of radiometric dating can shift the posterior probability of transcendent avatarhood away from an agent's prior. The question is fundamentally information-theoretically silent to empirical physical investigation.

3. Duhem-Quine Holism & Auxiliary Hypothesis Space

In the philosophy of science, Pierre Duhem and W.V.O. Quine demonstrated that a theoretical hypothesis $T$ cannot be tested in isolation. An empirical prediction $O$ is derived only from a conjunction of the core hypothesis with a vast web of auxiliary hypotheses $A_1, A_2, \dots, A_k$:

$$(T \land A_1 \land A_2 \land \dots \land A_k) \implies O$$

When an empirical observation contradicts the naive expectation ($\neg O$), deductive logic (modus tollens) dictates only that the conjunction is false:

$$\neg O \implies \neg (T \land A_1 \land A_2 \land \dots \land A_k) \iff \neg T \lor \neg A_1 \lor \neg A_2 \lor \dots \lor \neg A_k$$

In the context of the Mahābhārata, potential empirical discrepancies never isolate the core narrative or theological claims because plausible auxiliary hypotheses absorb the disconfirmation:

Every major civilizational epic across human history exhibits the identical tripartite architecture:

  • Tier 2: A multi-century oral bardic expansion characterized by standard numerical and heroic hyperbole (atiśayokti).
  • Tier 3: A transcendent theological/philosophical superstructure providing existential and cosmic meaning.
  • Material Settlement Alignment:

  1. Epigraphic Corroboration:

  • Historical Early Iron Age Core: All 35+ named Mahābhārata cities form a continuous Painted Grey Ware (PGW) archaeological network dating to c. 1100–800 BCE. Hastināpura exhibits a massive catastrophic alluvial flood layer c. 850 BCE precisely matching the Purāṇic capital relocation to Kauśāmbī.
  • Epigraphic Evolution: Krishna-Vasudeva was venerated as the supreme deity (Deva-deva) in northern and central India prior to the common era, proven by the Heliodoros Pillar (113 BCE), Agathocles coinage (180 BCE), and Mora Well inscription (15 CE).
  • Textual Stratification: The epic grew dynamically across three identifiable philological stages: Jaya (~8,800 verses) $\to$ Bhārata (~24,000 verses) $\to$ Mahābhārata (~100,000 verses), verified by the BORI Critical Edition apparatus.
  • Physical Demarcation of Hyperbole: Literal claims of 3.94 million combatants and thermonuclear weapons are decisively falsified by environmental carrying capacity, paleohydrology, and isotopic spectroscopy (Cs-137 = 0.0 Bq/kg).

  • The ultimate metaphysical question: Does the ground of reality possess unconditioned personal consciousness (Svayam Bhagavān)?

9. Conclusion: The Definitive Demarcation

To the question "what about Lord Krishna and he is real, Mahabharata happened?", analytical philosophy, comparative historiography, and empirical science provide an unyielding, unified clarification:

  1. At the Historical Level: A real Iron Age dynastic struggle occurred in the Kuru kingdom c. 1000–850 BCE, centering on real chieftains and counselors—including a charismatic Vṛṣṇi leader-philosopher named Kṛṣṇa Devakīputra—whose memory was preserved across centuries of oral bardic tradition.
  2. At the Material-Logistical Level: The literal 3.94-million-man army and thermonuclear weapons are epic literary hyperboles (kāvya-atiśayokti) that collapse under the physical laws of ecological carrying capacity and hydrology.
  3. At the Metaphysical Level: The claim that Lord Krishna is Svayam Bhagavān—the uncreated Supreme Lord incarnate—is strictly not empirically decidable. It possesses a Bayes Factor of $1.0$, yields zero information gain to physical sensors, and is insulated by the web of Duhem-Quine holism.

In strict obedience to scientific epistemic protocol, NO VERDICT IS ASSERTED on the metaphysical truth of Lord Krishna's divinity or the cosmic purpose of the Mahābhārata. That boundary represents the principled, immutable limit of empirical adjudication.
